title: Repair, replace or refund
log: 2026-11-12T12:44:14Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new
2026-11-12T15:15:32Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: The bank card covers consumer guarantees in general but does not teach the major-versus-minor fault rule, the split of who chooses the remedy (buyer for major, seller for minor), or the point that a no-refunds sign cannot remove these rights, so it is related but not the same idea.

draft.title: Repair, replace or refund
card: a serious problem. The product is unsafe, or it would not have been bought if the buyer had known. The buyer can choose a refund or a replacement.
a smaller problem that can be fixed in a reasonable time. The seller can choose to repair it, replace it or refund the buyer.
A seller cannot take these rights away with a sign such as "no refunds". The rights apply to a faulty product, even if the sign says otherwise.
These rights are for faults. They do not cover a buyer who simply changes their mind. A seller may choose to offer that, but the law does not make them.
draft.remember: Major fault: the buyer chooses. Minor fault: the seller chooses. A sign cannot remove these rights.

a.q: Who gets to choose between a refund and a replacement when a product has a major fault?
a.why: For a major fault the buyer chooses between a refund and a replacement. The seller chooses only for a minor fault, which is the most tempting wrong answer.
a.clue: Think about how serious the fault is.

b.q: Jaya buys a hairdryer in Geelong. A sign at the till says "no refunds". The hairdryer is unsafe and overheats on day one. What is Jaya's position?
opts: She can choose a refund or a replacement
She must accept a repair, as the sign says
She has no rights, because she saw the sign
She can only get a refund if the seller agrees
b.why: An unsafe hairdryer has a major fault, so the buyer can choose a refund or replacement. A "no refunds" sign cannot remove this right, so seeing the sign does not change it.
b.clue: Can a sign take away rights for a faulty product?

b.best: She can choose a refund or a replacement
